Messages.Author: Stone
Messages.Body:
hi,

Orgy of Blood does not have the text "Not usable by a vampire being burned
or going into torpor" that Disarm or Taste of Vitae have.

1/ If vampire A (1 blood, 1 strength) enters combat with ally B (1 life, 2
strength) and both use a hand strike, can A still play OoB even though A is
going to torpor ?

2/ If vampire A (1 blood, 1 strength) enters combat with ally B (1 life) ; A
declares hand strike, B strikes for 3 agg (say, Ivory Bow+Target Vitals),
can A still play OoB even though A is being burned ?

thanks
Stone

PS : question asked twice by e-mail within the last 3 weeks, LSJ did you
receive it ? ISP is a bit awry these days, but I didn't get any error
notification

Name: Orgy of Blood
[Sabbat:R, SW:R]
Cardtype: Combat
Only usable when a minion you control burns an ally controlled by another
Methuselah.
Each of your vampires gains X blood from the blood bank, where X is the
recruitment cost of the ally. (Remove excess blood.)
Artist: Harold Arthur McNeill

Name: Disarm
[Sabbat:R, SW:R, CE:PB, BH:PN, KMW:PAl, Third:R]
Cardtype: Combat
Discipline: Potence
[pot] Only usable at the end of a round of combat in which this vampire
successfully inflicted more damage at close range than the opposing vampire.
Not usable by a vampire being burned or going into torpor. Put this card on
the opposing vampire and send that vampire into torpor. The vampire with
this card has -1 strength. He or she may burn this card by burning 3 blood.
A vampire can have only one Disarm.
[POT] As above, but the vampire with this card has -2 strength.
Artist: L. A. Williams

Name: Taste of Vitae
[Jyhad:U, VTES:U, SW:PB, CE:U/PB2/PN, BH:PN2, KMW:PAn2, LoB:PO2, Third:PB2,
LotN:PG2, KoT:U/PB3/PT3]
Cardtype: Combat
Only usable at the end of a round of combat. Not usable by a vampire being
burned or going to torpor.
This vampire gains an amount of blood equal to the amount lost by the
opposing vampire to damage during this round. A vampire may play only one
Taste of Vitae each round.
Artist: Pete Venters; Brian LeBlanc
